high_level_description: This image captures Queen Sirikit of Thailand standing before a porcelain-encrusted tower within one of the many pavilions of the Grand Palace. The setting is a grand and ornate courtyard, characterized by traditional Thai architecture with intricate details. People: The central figure is Queen Sirikit, dressed in a traditional Thai outfit. She wears a long, purple skirt with a matching jacket, adorned with a gold necklace. Her hair is styled in an elegant updo, typical of royal attire. She stands confidently with her hands resting on the railing of the stone structure she is leaning
